title: Zephyr: ACK_TIMEOUT=15s, MAX_RETRANSMIT=2
close_reason: Fixed ACK_TIMEOUT=15s: updated LICHEN_COAP_TIMEOUT_MS (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/include/lichen/coap_client.h) and CONFIG_COAP_INIT_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS (lichen/apps/puck/prj.conf) from 5000ms to 15000ms. MAX_RETRANSMIT=2 not implemented: Zephyr v3.7.0 coap_client does not expose a Kconfig option for max retransmit count (uses RFC 7252 default of 4). Implementing this would require either patching Zephyr or creating a LICHEN-specific retransmit wrapper.
